title: Deterministic average query count
statement: Let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on a finite alphabet, and let $T$ be a deterministic decision tree on $n$ coordinates. The average cost of $T$ is the expected number of coordinates queried when the input coordinates are sampled independently from $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a deterministic decision tree on $n$ coordinates.
$\pi$ is a probability distribution on the alphabet.
